_comment: Pins capitalAvoided() and stack() across the collection-rate unification, where $550/kW moved from site-infrastructure.js's own constant onto SiteCapex.DEFAULT_RATES. The value did not change, so both digests are identical before and after -- they were computed on both sides of the edit and compared. Sensitivity was then demonstrated rather than assumed: nudging the rate to 551 breaks the capitalAvoided digest across all 11,829 candidates, so an unchanged digest means the arithmetic really is unchanged.
verified: digests computed pre-edit and post-edit and found equal; sensitivity confirmed at 551/kW
